name: SentinelOps
description: Agent-accessible ITSM incident management with scoped actions, audited triage, and approved knowledge search.

skills.description: Create and request typed triage for an incident; requires incidents:create.
List or retrieve incidents; requires incidents:read.
Read incident events via SSE; requires events:read.
Claim an unassigned incident; requires incidents:claim.
Search approved, embedded knowledge; requires kb:read.
Hand an incident to a human/group with a structured brief; requires handoff:create.
Resolve an incident with validated citations; requires incidents:resolve.
